about: Every repository that pins this compiler. scripts/sync_downstreams.rb reads this list after each release: it moves each pin file to the new version and its hashes, raises the revision of each formula listed under list_of_formulae_to_rebuild so Homebrew rebuilds it on the new compiler, opens one pull request per repository, starts each tap's bottles workflow once that pull request merges, and fails its check while any pin file still names an earlier release. Add a repository here in the same pull request that makes it pin the compiler.

list_of_downstreams.what_it_ships: amber, amber-lsp and minecart, bottled for macOS arm64
Amber V2 CI job that builds crystal-alpha from its tag commit and runs the suite on it
list_of_downstreams.how_to_sync: In the crystal-alpha job set CRYSTAL_ALPHA_COMMIT and the checkout ref to the tag's peeled commit, CRYSTAL_ALPHA_TREE to its tree, the job name and the --version grep to the new version and short commit.

list_of_downstreams.what_it_ships: the crystal-stack package that installs the compiler on member Macs
list_of_downstreams.how_to_sync: Raise the crystal-stack package version, pin the new tap bottles commit and the arm64_tahoe bottle sha256 in steps.sh, and roll it out test Mac first (docs/ROLLOUTS.md).

list_of_downstreams.what_it_ships: the fleet health baseline: which compiler each Mac must have
list_of_downstreams.how_to_sync: Move the agent-crystal entries to the new version, keg path and binary sha256 once agentc-mdm's crystal-stack rollout has reached every Mac.

list_of_downstreams.what_it_ships: the WASM build toolchain lock and its Linux CI runner toolchain
list_of_downstreams.how_to_sync: Point tools/build_wasm.rb and the locks at the new keg, record the binary sha256s, and rebuild the runner toolchain release for CI.

list_of_downstreams.what_it_ships: the premium template's self-hosted runner SDK and its WASM toolchain lock
list_of_downstreams.how_to_sync: Provision the runner SDK for the new version (tooling/runner-toolchain), then move these paths and their sha256 inputs to it.
